+name: Lumo Dream connections native acceptance
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [integration/lumo-dream-connections-20261114]
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: lumo-dream-connections-integration-lumo-dream-connections-20261114
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  dream-native-acceptance:
+    if: >-
+      github.repository == 'Ullmann27/lumo-godot' &&
+      github.event_name == 'push' &&
+      github.ref == 'refs/heads/integration/lumo-dream-connections-20261114'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    # Existing headless budgets: 60 + 180 + 420 + 420 seconds.
+    # Dream budgets: two 120-second and three 180-second probes.
+    # The remaining job budget covers installation, import, tests and upload.
+    timeout-minutes: 45
+    defaults:
+      run:
+        shell: bash
+    env:
+      LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE: '1'
+      GODOT_SILENCE_ROOT_WARNING: '1'
+      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
+      GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS: '0'
+    steps:
+      - name: Check out the exact internal Dream push
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Bind the original source and external evidence directories
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          LUMO_DREAM_ROOT="$RUNNER_TEMP/lumo-dream-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
+          LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR="$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT/evidence"
+          mkdir "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT"
+          mkdir -p "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source" \
+            "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/tests" "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/headless" \
+            "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT/engine" "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT/tmp" \
+            "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT/xdg/data" "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT/xdg/config" "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT/xdg/cache"
+          {
+            printf 'LUMO_DREAM_ROOT=%s\n' "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT"
+            printf 'LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR=%s\n' "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR"
+            printf 'GODOT_BIN=%s/engine/bin/godot\n' "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT"
+            printf 'LUMO_DREAM_PYTHON=%s/venv/bin/python\n' "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT"
+            printf 'LUMO_DREAM_LOG_DIR=%s/dream\n' "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR"
+            printf 'LUMO_EXPECTED_NATIVE_SHA=%s\n' "$GITHUB_SHA"
+            printf 'TMPDIR=%s/tmp\n' "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT"
+            printf 'XDG_DATA_HOME=%s/xdg/data\n' "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT"
+            printf 'XDG_CONFIG_HOME=%s/xdg/config\n' "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT"
+            printf 'XDG_CACHE_HOME=%s/xdg/cache\n' "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT"
+          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          git rev-parse HEAD > "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/sha-before.txt"
+          git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}' > "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/tree-before.txt"
+          git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no > "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/status-before.txt"
+          git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all > "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/all-status-before.txt"
+          git ls-files --stage > "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/index-before.txt"
+          sha256sum "$(git rev-parse --git-path index)" | cut -d ' ' -f 1 \
+            > "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/index-sha256-before.txt"
+          printf 'repository=%s\nref=%s\nsource=%s\nrun=%s\nattempt=%s\njob=%s\n' \
+            "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" "$GITHUB_REF" "$GITHUB_SHA" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
+            "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" "$GITHUB_JOB" > "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/workflow-context.txt"
+          test "$(cat "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/sha-before.txt")" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
+          test ! -s "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/status-before.txt"
+
+      - name: Install the verified engine and external Pillow environment
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          {
+            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=2 update -qq &&
+            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=2 install -y xvfb libgl1-mesa-dri libglx-mesa0 python3-venv &&
+            curl -fL --retry 3 -o "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT/engine/godot.zip" \
+              https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.6.3-stable/Godot_v4.6.3-stable_linux.x86_64.zip &&
+            printf '%s  %s\n' d0bc2113065e481c9c2c2b2c37daa4e8be3fe9e27f0ab9ab0b6096e9a37907f3 \
+              "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT/engine/godot.zip" | sha256sum -c - &&
+            unzip -q "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT/engine/godot.zip" -d "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT/engine/bin" &&
+            ln -s "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT/engine/bin/Godot_v4.6.3-stable_linux.x86_64" "$GODOT_BIN" &&
+            "$GODOT_BIN" --version > "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/engine.txt" &&
+            cat "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/engine.txt" &&
+            test "$(cat "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/engine.txt")" = 4.6.3.stable.official.7d41c59c4 &&
+            python3 -m venv "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT/venv" &&
+            "$LUMO_DREAM_PYTHON" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-cache-dir Pillow==12.3.0 &&
+            "$LUMO_DREAM_PYTHON" --version &&
+            "$LUMO_DREAM_PYTHON" -c 'import PIL; print("Pillow " + PIL.__version__); assert PIL.__version__ == "12.3.0"' &&
+            command -v xvfb-run &&
+            printf '%s\n' "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT/engine/bin" "$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT/venv/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+          } 2>&1 | tee "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/setup.log"
+
+      - name: Require the separate Dream raster counterexamples
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          "$LUMO_DREAM_PYTHON" -m unittest tools.tests.test_dream_rasters -v \
+            2>&1 | tee "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/tests/dream-raster-tests.log"
+
+      - name: Import the exact production project with a strict error guard
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 420s "$GODOT_BIN" \
+            --headless --audio-driver Dummy --path "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --editor --import --quit \
+            2>&1 | tee "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/import.log"
+          if grep -En 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:|Assertion failed|ObjectDB instances leaked|resources still in use at exit' \
+            "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/import.log"; then
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+      - name: Preserve the four existing exact headless acceptance gates
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          check_headless() {
+            local name="$1" seconds="$2" marker="$3"
+            local proof="$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/headless/$name.log"
+            local state="$LUMO_DREAM_ROOT/xdg/$name"
+            mkdir -p "$state/data" "$state/config" "$state/cache" || return 1
+            XDG_DATA_HOME="$state/data" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$state/config" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$state/cache" \
+              "$LUMO_DREAM_PYTHON" tools/run_godot_probe.py \
+              --log "$proof" --timeout "$seconds" --required "$marker" -- \
+              "$GODOT_BIN" --headless --audio-driver Dummy --path "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
+              --script "res://scripts/tests/$name.gd" || return $?
+            if grep -En 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:|Assertion failed|ObjectDB instances leaked|resources still in use at exit' "$proof"; then
+              return 1
+            fi
+            local count
+            if ! count="$(grep -Fxc -- "$marker" "$proof")"; then
+              return 1
+            fi
+            test "$count" = 1
+          }
+          {
+            check_headless connect_four_return_regression 60 'CONNECT_FOUR_RETURN_PASS checks=21' || exit 1
+            check_headless treasure_wisp_regression 180 '[TreasureWisp] PASS checks=14' || exit 1
+            check_headless treasure_exploration_regression 420 \
+              '[TreasureExploration] PASS 92 checks: branching, actual location questions, movement, legacy saves and original rewards' || exit 1
+            check_headless learning_world_regression 420 '[LearningWorld] PASS checks=5347' || exit 1
+          } 2>&1 | tee "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/headless/runner.log"
+
+      - name: Collect all five new Dream gates and seven original renderer images
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test ! -e "$LUMO_DREAM_LOG_DIR"
+          test ! -L "$LUMO_DREAM_LOG_DIR"
+          test "$LUMO_EXPECTED_NATIVE_SHA" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
+          bash tools/validate_dream_connections.sh 2>&1 | tee "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/dream-runner.log"
+          test "$(grep -Fxc '[LumoDreamConnections] PASS 5 original probes and 7 verified renderer PNGs' \
+            "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/dream-runner.log")" = 1
+
+      - name: Always preserve final source and index identities
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/lumo-dream-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT/evidence"
+          mkdir -p "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source"
+          git rev-parse HEAD > "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/sha-after.txt"
+          git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}' > "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/tree-after.txt"
+          git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no > "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/status-after.txt"
+          git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all > "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/all-status-after.txt"
+          git ls-files --stage > "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/index-after.txt"
+          sha256sum "$(git rev-parse --git-path index)" | cut -d ' ' -f 1 \
+            > "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/index-sha256-after.txt"
+          cmp "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/sha-before.txt" "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/sha-after.txt"
+          cmp "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/tree-before.txt" "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/tree-after.txt"
+          cmp "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/index-before.txt" "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/index-after.txt"
+          cmp "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/index-sha256-before.txt" "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/index-sha256-after.txt"
+          test ! -s "$LUMO_DREAM_EVIDENCE_DIR/source/status-after.txt"
+
+      - name: Preserve the original Dream workflow evidence even after failure
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: lumo-dream-connections-native-evidence-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/lumo-dream-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/evidence/
+          include-hidden-files: true
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 30

+name: LUMO learning wonder detail proof
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [chatgpt/lumo-learning-wonder-details-20261114]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: lumo-learning-wonder-${{ github.sha }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+jobs:
+  learning-wonder:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 30
+    env:
+      LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE: '1'
+      LP_NUM_THREADS: '2'
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - name: Exact Godot and immutable source capsule
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          mkdir -p evidence capsule
+          git rev-parse HEAD > evidence/source-sha.txt
+          git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}' > evidence/source-tree.txt
+          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=2 update -qq
+          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=2 install -y xvfb libgl1-mesa-dri libglx-mesa0
+          curl -fL --retry 3 -o capsule/godot.zip https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.6.3-stable/Godot_v4.6.3-stable_linux.x86_64.zip
+          printf '%s  %s\n' d0bc2113065e481c9c2c2b2c37daa4e8be3fe9e27f0ab9ab0b6096e9a37907f3 capsule/godot.zip | sha256sum -c -
+          unzip -q capsule/godot.zip -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot-bin"
+          ln -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot-bin/Godot_v4.6.3-stable_linux.x86_64" "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot-bin/godot"
+          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot-bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+          git archive --format=zip --output=capsule/source.zip HEAD project.godot icon.svg scripts scenes assets tools
+          cp evidence/source-sha.txt evidence/source-tree.txt capsule/
+          sha256sum capsule/godot.zip capsule/source.zip > capsule/SHA256SUMS.txt
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: lumo-learning-wonder-source-runtime
+          path: capsule/
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 7
+          compression-level: 0
+      - name: Import production assets with strict error gate
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          export XDG_DATA_HOME="$PWD/evidence/user-data"
+          timeout 480 godot --headless --editor --import --quit 2>&1 | tee evidence/import.log
+          if grep -qE 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:' evidence/import.log; then exit 1; fi
+      - name: Existing learning, sharing, Studio and ambience regression
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          export XDG_DATA_HOME="$PWD/evidence/unit-user-data"
+          for probe in learning_world_regression learning_sharing_regression learning_studio_regression lumo_dream_ambience_regression; do
+            timeout 150 godot --headless --path . --audio-driver Dummy --script "scripts/tests/$probe.gd" 2>&1 | tee "evidence/$probe.log"
+            grep -E 'PASS|0 failures' "evidence/$probe.log"
+            if grep -qE 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:' "evidence/$probe.log"; then exit 1; fi
+          done
+      - name: New production scene state and accessibility regression
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          export XDG_DATA_HOME="$PWD/evidence/state-user-data"
+          timeout 150 godot --headless --path . --audio-driver Dummy --script scripts/tests/learning_wonder_details_regression.gd 2>&1 | tee evidence/wonder-headless.log
+          grep -F 'failures=0' evidence/wonder-headless.log
+          if grep -qE 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:' evidence/wonder-headless.log; then exit 1; fi
+          timeout 420 xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 2560x2560x24' godot --path . --rendering-method gl_compatibility --audio-driver Dummy --script scripts/tests/learning_wonder_details_regression.gd 2>&1 | tee evidence/wonder-renderer.log
+          grep -F 'invalid_scene_checked=true' evidence/wonder-renderer.log
+          grep -F 'failures=0' evidence/wonder-renderer.log
+          if grep -qE 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:' evidence/wonder-renderer.log; then exit 1; fi
+      - name: Existing unmodified real-touch learning captures
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          export XDG_DATA_HOME="$PWD/evidence/legacy-capture-user-data"
+          timeout 600 xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 2560x2560x24' godot --path . --rendering-method gl_compatibility --audio-driver Dummy --script scripts/tests/learning_world_capture.gd -- --output="$PWD/evidence/learning-images" 2>&1 | tee evidence/learning-render.log
+          grep -F '[LearningCapture] PASS' evidence/learning-render.log
+          if grep -qE 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:' evidence/learning-render.log; then exit 1; fi
+      - name: Exact flower geometry, screen bounds and original after images
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          export XDG_DATA_HOME="$PWD/evidence/wonder-capture-user-data"
+          timeout 420 xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 2560x2560x24' godot --path . --rendering-method gl_compatibility --audio-driver Dummy --script scripts/tests/learning_wonder_details_capture.gd -- --output="$PWD/evidence/wonder-images" 2>&1 | tee evidence/wonder-capture.log
+          grep -F 'failures=0 captures=11' evidence/wonder-capture.log
+          if grep -qE 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:' evidence/wonder-capture.log; then exit 1; fi
+          find evidence/learning-images evidence/wonder-images -type f -name '*.png' -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > evidence/image-sha256.txt
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: lumo-learning-wonder-evidence
+          path: evidence/
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 30

+name: LUMO magical native game hub real regression
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [chatgpt/lumo-magic-gamehub-portals-20261114]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: lumo-magic-hub-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+jobs:
+  native-game-hub:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 23
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - name: Install pinned Godot 4.6.3
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          curl -fL --retry 3 -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot.zip" https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.6.3-stable/Godot_v4.6.3-stable_linux.x86_64.zip
+          printf '%s  %s\n' d0bc2113065e481c9c2c2b2c37daa4e8be3fe9e27f0ab9ab0b6096e9a37907f3 "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot.zip" | sha256sum -c -
+          unzip -q "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot.zip" -d "$RUNNER_TEMP"
+          mv "$RUNNER_TEMP/Godot_v4.6.3-stable_linux.x86_64" "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot"
+          chmod +x "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot"
+      - name: Import original native project including its real 3D assets
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot" --headless --path . --editor --import --quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/hub-import.log
+          if grep -E 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|Failed to load script' /tmp/hub-import.log; then exit 1; fi
+      - name: Exercise live Godot scene, route cards, economic village and 3D decoration
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          timeout 90 "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot" --headless --path . --script res://scripts/tests/game_hub_magic_regression.gd 2>&1 | tee /tmp/hub-test.log
+          grep -F '[LumoHub] PASS' /tmp/hub-test.log
+          if grep -E 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|Assertion failed|ERROR:' /tmp/hub-test.log; then exit 1; fi
+      - name: Capture real rendered 3D hub – phone and Fold landscape
+        env:
+          LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE: '1'
+          LUMO_HUB_CAPTURE_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/proof
+        run: |

+# LUMO 3D Lernatelier: richtige Handlungen werden zu sichtbaren Sternen
+
+Kinder sollen die Magie in ihrer bestehenden Lernwelt erleben, nicht durch zusätzliche Menüs oder unpassende Punktejagd.
+
+- Ein erfolgreich gelegter Rechenwürfel bzw. eine korrekt angeordnete Silbe erzeugt einen kleinen räumlichen Sternenkranz am realen Ziel.
+- Beim wirklichen Beobachten von Wurzel, Stängel, Blättern und Blüte sowie bei Wasser und Sonne reagiert die Pflanze mit demselben Effekt.
+- Falsche Silben und abgebrochene Gesten erzeugen niemals fälschlich eine Belohnungsanimation.
+- Die alte Original-Lumo-Figur, vorhandenen Objekte, UI-Safe-Areas, Lernbewertung, Stimme und Steuerung bleiben erhalten.
+- Eine einzige wiederverwendete 20-Quad-Instanzgruppe; keine Pfadsterne, neuen Lichter, Schatten oder Kollisionen. Reduzierte Bewegung hält den Kranz still, App-Pause stoppt das VFX-Timing.
+- Headless Godot prüft die tatsächliche Produktionsszene, Korrektheit falscher/richtiger Eingaben, alle vorhandenen Layout-/Lernkontrakte und dieselbe 3D-Effektkomponente. Android-API35/37 und Fold7 sind eigene anschließende Freigabestufen.
+
+Der PR baut auf dem separat geprüften Schatzinsel-Effekt auf und verändert weder main noch Familien-APK. Keine UI-Versprechen ohne native Originalbilder.

+# LUMO: Zauberhafte Sternenpfade auf der Schatzinsel
+
+## Kindererlebnis
+Originale räumliche Lichtsternchen führen entlang des tatsächlich freigeschalteten Abenteuers. Gold steht für das erste Ziel, Mond-Cyan für den zweiten Ast an der Weggabelung. Nach einer tatsächlichen Entdeckung oder korrekt beantworteten Frage entsteht ein kleiner Sternenkranz um Lumo. Nach dem Schatzfund zeigen die Spuren keine falschen Ziele mehr.
+
+## Technik und Abnahme
+- Echter Godot Spatial Shader und Camera-Billboards, maximal 16+16 instanzierte Führungssterne und 20 wiederverwendete Erfolgssterne; keine zusätzlichen Lichter, Schatten, Kollisionen, Touchflächen oder Texturen.
+- Update der visualisierten Instanzen auf 24 Hz begrenzt. Reduzierte Bewegung stoppt das Schweben und lässt die Marker stehen; pausierte Dialoge stoppen dekorative Animationen.
+- Die komplette Quest-, Speicher-, Kapitel- und XP-Autorität verbleibt unverändert in TreasureState. Die künstlerische Erweiterung kann dadurch niemals einen Schatz oder Fortschritt fingieren.
+- Der neue quellgebundene CI-Workflow importiert das Originalprojekt, führt separate Sternen- und bestehende Spielpfad-Regressionen aus und zeichnet drei unverfälschte Godot-Bilder auf. Für Freigabe sind erfolgreiche Jobs und Sichtkontrolle erforderlich.
+- Dieser PR verbessert ausdrücklich die Schatzinsel, noch nicht jede Welt und noch nicht das endgültige Android-Paket. Kein Merge nach main; Android-Signierung, Geräte-FPS und Freigabe sind weiterhin gesonderte Prüfungen.
+
+Design: warmes Märchengold, sternförmige Lichtkerne, zartes Mond-Cyan, aufmerksames, kindgerechtes Orientieren statt aufdringlicher Menü-Overlays.

+# Kart minimap: actual bounded repair and counterexample
+
+The original minimap overflow is reproduced by the existing Safe-Area test, and the reviewed correction passes the same test bytes. This is a source-bound Godot geometry result. It does not replace a new rendered or Android-device acceptance.
+
+## Exact integration basis
+
+The audited Kart source was `f0c19f9eb69ea330ac5d2b8f9948cb029ca218aa`. Integration and actual local runs use its direct successor `f052c2795b765265dbb6f5c27b9e92b557d39a39`, tree `35492eec16cac6774bc546b6e57628900bef61cb`. Both owned baseline files are byte-identical at those commits. The successor tree preserves all intervening Treasure/learning-feedback files.
+
+| File | Original blob | Reviewed and executed candidate blob |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| scripts/games/kart_island.gd | f7473190f51fb5dbda7d0f7ad7292f8ec64c0da2 | 83b3b6b548cffa2790c582e061a74e37bbfcf356 |
+| scripts/tests/mobile_safe_area_regression.gd | 61ded805fdbc70c3499814b4e8f74214079fc96c | 6c58c08b8c47a7bf7c957c448b88474a984b9509 |
+
+## Observed original defect
+
+The unchanged 2400 × 1080 Android upgrade images `21_race_driving_late_2.png` and `21_lumo_kart_real_race.png` show the minimap cut by the right image edge and covering the upper SPEED artwork. The worker personally inspected both before the runtime reset; the independent reviewer later fetched and personally inspected the first original again. Its durable location, full image hashes and limits are recorded in `manifest.json` and `independent-review.json`.
+
+The old top-right panel used fixed offsets while its child's 160 × 128 minimum grew with UI density. Container padding added another 14 units on each edge. The required panel could grow beyond the positioned rectangle and draw over controls added earlier to the scene. Both minimap nodes ignore pointer events, so these screenshots alone are not evidence of intercepted touch events.
+
+## What changed
+
+The production change is confined to minimap layout in `kart_island.gd`. It observes actual settled safe-area and HUD geometry, reserves the entire instruction and visible jump-hint rectangles, and considers the safe right edge followed by the actual control edges. All visible header buttons, the joystick and pedal artwork are excluded. Pedal artwork is explicitly checked at its unchanged 1.12× drawn extent.
+
+The passive map keeps its aspect and may use an 80 × 64 dp content minimum. Its minimum is no longer re-expanded by the generic UI scaler. A newly shown or hidden jump hint queues fresh layout through real visibility/rectangle signals. Compact, short and arena optional-map behavior remains. Driving controls, physics, action handlers and assets are unchanged. Of 142 previous production functions, 139 are byte-identical; three existing layout functions and two new helpers implement the correction.
+
+The independent first review identified an instruction-row omission in the initial draft. The second draft fixed it before execution. The immutable independent review addresses exactly the production and test blobs shown above.
+
+## Actual unchanged-test comparison
+
+Both runs used the already installed Godot `4.6.3.stable.official.7d41c59c4`, the same new test blob and separate temporary user-data directories. Sources were hashed before and after each run and did not change.
+
+| Run | Production | Checks | Failed checks | Exit | Elapsed |
+| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
+| Original baseline | f052 original Kart | 380 | 26 | 1 | 14.813 s |
+| Reviewed candidate | exact V2 Kart blob | 380 | 0 | 0 | 15.474 s |
+
+The original failures are minimap/control/notice overlap, escape from true safe bounds and failure to reposition when the live hint appears. All original fifteen Safe-Area control records remain. Seven added profiles cover dense left/right cutouts, changed density at identical pixels, an expanded inner display, compact portrait, short landscape and restoration. A focused two-step hint show/hide cycle uses the real hint API without a viewport resize or manual layout call.
+
+In the dense left-cutout result the visible map panel is approximately `(1495.56, 431.25, 406.51, 333.60)` physical fixture pixels, fully inside the measured safe rectangle `(136, 63, 2264, 954)`. On the expanded display the real hint moves its top from `359.46` to `511.98` pixels and hiding it restores `359.46`. These are actual headless Control geometry observations, not rendered screenshots.
+
+Both runs emit the same two nonfatal compatibility-renderer warnings about screen-space AA and volumetric fog. The candidate has no script/runtime error lines and the original report records zero failed checks. Raw logs, reports and invocation records are preserved without editing under `red/` and `green/`; `result-summary.json` records the diagnostics explicitly.
+
+## Mandatory gates preserved
+
+Removing only the additions reconstructs the entire old Safe-Area test byte-for-byte. Its fifteen original control targets, four original rendered Mobile images, existing scene/cache/reader/workshop assertions and failure behavior remain intact. The unchanged `tools/validate_nextgen.sh` still has exactly 52 probe/mode invocations and runs this test both headless and rendered. Its old raster verifier remains unchanged.
+
+Additional Kart PNGs use a separate `LUMO_KART_MINIMAP_CAPTURE_DIR`, set only for a real `--capture` invocation. They do not replace or alter the four existing required Mobile raster fields. The checked-in invocation record is the actual local headless run; the full 52-mode suite was not duplicated locally.
+
+## Rendering limitation
+
+The installed Xorg/dummy setup was attempted in an isolated task directory. Xorg exited 1 because it could not create listening sockets. A separate task-owned Unix-socket probe also received `EPERM / Operation not permitted`. No new renderer image was produced, no dummy image was substituted, and no new engine or permission workaround was installed. Original startup logs and configuration are preserved under `display/`.
+
+A genuine candidate render/device check and the ordinary full candidate CI remain required. There is no claim of Android interaction, frame rate, audio, whole-app completion or Play Store readiness from this bounded repair.

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+
+def identity(data: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    return (hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(data)).encode() + b'\0' + data).hexdigest(),
+            hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())
+
+
+def regular(path: Path) -> bytes:
+    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+        raise ValueError(f'Expected original regular file: {path}')
+    return path.read_bytes()
+
+
+def main(spec_path: Path) -> None:
+    spec = json.loads(spec_path.read_text())
+    root = Path(spec['output_directory'])
+    if root.exists():

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+
+def identity(data: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    return (hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(data)).encode() + b'\0' + data).hexdigest(),
+            hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())
+
+
+def regular(path: Path) -> bytes:
+    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+        raise ValueError(f'Expected original regular file: {path}')
+    return path.read_bytes()
+
+
+def main(spec_path: Path) -> None:
+    spec = json.loads(spec_path.read_text())
+    root = Path(spec['output_directory'])
+    if root.exists():
+        raise ValueError('Refusing to overwrite an existing prepared publication')
+    documents = root / 'documents'
+    chunks_dir = root / 'gitdata'
+    documents.mkdir(parents=True)
+    chunks_dir.mkdir()
+    files = []
+    archive_records = []
+    loader = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('evidence_archive', '/tmp/lumo-root-recovery-0900/prepare_host79_evidence.py')
+    helper = importlib.util.module_from_spec(loader)
+    loader.loader.exec_module(helper)
+    helper.DOCS = documents
+    for item in spec.get('copies', []):
+        archive_records.append(helper.copy_original(Path(item['source']), item['destination'], item.get('sha256')))
+    for item in spec.get('archives', []):
+        archive_records.append(helper.archive_pack(Path(item['source']), item['destination'], item['manifest_sha256']))
+    for item in spec.get('source_files', []):
+        source = Path(item['source'])
+        data = regular(source)
+        blob, sha256 = identity(data)
+        if blob != item['git_blob'] or sha256 != item['sha256']:
+            raise ValueError(f'Frozen source identity changed: {source}')
+        files.append({'path': item['path'], 'source': str(source), 'mode': item.get('mode', '100644')})
+    (documents / 'root-connection.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec['connection'], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
+    (documents / 'original-archive-bindings.json').write_text(json.dumps({'schema': 1, 'files': archive_records}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
+    (documents / 'prepare-connection.py').write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
+    for source in sorted(documents.rglob('*')):
+        if source.is_file():
+            files.append({'path': spec['evidence_prefix'] + '/' + source.relative_to(documents).as_posix(),
+                          'source': str(source), 'mode': '100644'})
+    entries = []
+    blobs = []
+    local_files = []
+    inventory = []
+    paths = set()
+    seen_blobs = set()
+    for item in files:
+        path = item['path']
+        if path.startswith('/') or any(p in ('', '.', '..') for p in path.split('/')) or path in paths:
+            raise ValueError(f'Unsafe or duplicate publication path: {path}')
+        paths.add(path)
+        data = regular(Path(item['source']))
+        sha, sha256 = identity(data)
+        entry = {'path': path, 'mode': item['mode'], 'type': 'blob', 'sha': sha}
+        entries.append(entry)
+        local_files.append({'entry': entry, 'file': item['source']})
+        inventory.append({'path': path, 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': sha256, 'git_blob': sha})
+        if sha in seen_blobs:
+            continue
+        seen_blobs.add(sha)
+        try:
+            content = data.decode('utf-8')
+            encoding = 'utf-8'
+        except UnicodeDecodeError:
+            content = base64.b64encode(data).decode('ascii')
+            encoding = 'base64'
+        chunks = []
+        for offset in range(0, max(1, len(content)), 30000):
+            chunk = chunks_dir / f'{sha}-{offset // 30000:04d}.chunk'
+            chunk.write_bytes(content[offset:offset + 30000].encode('utf-8'))
+            chunks.append(str(chunk))
+        blobs.append({'sha': sha, 'encoding': encoding, 'bytes': len(data), 'characters': len(content),
+                      'chunks': chunks, 'source_path': path})
+    plan = {key: spec[key] for key in ('repository_full_name', 'parent_sha', 'base_tree', 'branch_name', 'message')}
+    plan.update({'local_commit': None, 'entries': entries, 'blobs': blobs})
+    result = {'plan': plan, 'local_files': local_files, 'inventory': inventory}
+    (root / 'prepared.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
+    print(json.dumps({'prepared': str(root / 'prepared.json'), 'paths': len(entries),
+                      'source_paths': len(spec.get('source_files', [])), 'bytes': sum(x['bytes'] for x in inventory)}, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main(Path(sys.argv[1]))

+# Native Dream / minimap integration
+
+This checkpoint merges the exact Dream parent `bd0712259bb64908a5649ee1999638826c9eb597` and reviewed minimap parent `6ecc560ea16202b935c4f1d32b08b93cda358e02`. Their verified common ancestor is `f052c2795b765265dbb6f5c27b9e92b557d39a39`.
+
+## Preserved source
+
+The Dream side changes 42 paths and the minimap side changes 22 paths from that ancestor. The changed-path intersection is empty. Every mode, type and blob in the full union was verified against the created tree `71a6ca75c3c21de70ae857d2d5c3b259c7db7f1a` (3,637 non-tree entries). This evidence is then added without altering that union.
+
+The merge uses two real Git parents through GitData. It does not claim a command-line git merge execution. No remote branch/ref or Host pin was changed by this operation.
+
+The final Kart source remains blob `83b3b6b548cffa2790c582e061a74e37bbfcf356`; the existing extended SafeArea test remains blob `6c58c08b8c47a7bf7c957c448b88474a984b9509`. The previous minimap red/green, independent review and display limitation remain intact under `docs/evidence/kart-minimap-safe-area-20261114/`. All Dream assets, code and evidence remain intact. The existing 52-mode runner and the separate Dream runner/workflow/verifier retain their parent blob identities.
+
+## Actual bounded integration run
+
+Direct Kart and safe-area dependencies did not change on the Dream side. Three LearningAtelier/environment sources loaded by the existing SafeArea probe did change, so one focused integration run was warranted. The exact changes and reviewed new visual dependencies are recorded in `dependency-review.json`.
+
+The isolated checkout used exact Dream HEAD plus only the two tested minimap source overrides. It physically copied the prior private import cache, then ran the existing engine's asset import. Import completed successfully (5.353 seconds); its one missing UID cache warning and original log are preserved.
+
+The same existing SafeArea test then completed on Godot `4.6.3.stable.official.7d41c59c4`:
+
+- Started: 2026-11-14T11:29:03.473121+00:00.
+- Exit 0; 380 checks, zero failures, 15 existing controls, zero captured images.
+- Duration: 14.646 seconds.
+- All 1,454 materialized tracked files were verified against the exact parent-plus-two-overrides before and after execution. Their inventory was unchanged.
+- No script/runtime errors appeared. The same two nonfatal compatibility-renderer warnings about screen-space AA and volumetric fog are retained in the original log.
+
+The old red run was not repeated. No full 52-mode, Dream raster, Android, performance, audio or touch-device validation is claimed by this narrow integration run. No new PNG was generated. The prior display capability restriction is retained in the minimap evidence; no new display workaround was attempted.
+
+## Evidence
+
+`source-preservation.json` records exact ancestry, every changed entry and the full-union verification. `manifest.json` hashes all original execution records. `run_integration.py` is the actual invocation wrapper with explicit parent and source guards. The integration source is reproducible from the two parents without changing any product/test bytes.

+import argparse

+import json

+
+STAGE = Path("/home/agent/lumo-kart-dream-merge-2708")
+SOURCE = STAGE / "source"
+DREAM = "bd0712259bb64908a5649ee1999638826c9eb597"
+DREAM_TREE = "2eb628d3e3a327ee8985385130c96168db7aa852"
+OVERRIDES = {
+    "scripts/games/kart_island.gd": "83b3b6b548cffa2790c582e061a74e37bbfcf356",
+    "scripts/tests/mobile_safe_area_regression.gd": "6c58c08b8c47a7bf7c957c448b88474a984b9509",
+}
+DEPENDENCIES = [
+    "project.godot",
+    "scripts/learning/learning_atelier.gd",

+    "scripts/systems/render/lumo_environment.gd",

+    "scripts/systems/render/lumo_dream_ambience.gd",

+    "assets/dream_garden/dream_storybook.glb",
+    "tools/validate_nextgen.sh",
+    "tools/validate_dream_connections.sh",
+    "tools/verify_dream_rasters.py",
+    ".github/workflows/lumo-dream-connections.yml",
+]
+
+def git(*args):
+    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(SOURCE), *args], text=True).strip()
+
+def identity(path):
+    data = (SOURCE / path).read_bytes()
+    return {
+        "path": path, "bytes": len(data),
+        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
+        "git_blob": hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data).hexdigest(),
+    }
+
+def snapshot():
+    if git("rev-parse", "HEAD") != DREAM or git("rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}") != DREAM_TREE:
+        raise RuntimeError("Unexpected isolated source commit/tree")
+    rows = []
+    missing = []
+    expected = {}
+    index = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(SOURCE), "ls-files", "--stage", "-z"])
+    for record in index.split(b"\0"):
+        if not record:
+            continue
+        metadata, raw_path = record.split(b"\t", 1)
+        mode, sha, stage = metadata.decode().split()
+        path = raw_path.decode()
+        if stage != "0":
+            raise RuntimeError("Unmerged source entry: " + path)
+        expected[path] = OVERRIDES.get(path, sha)
+        file = SOURCE / path
+        if not file.exists():
+            missing.append(path)
+            continue
+        if file.is_symlink() or not file.is_file():
+            raise RuntimeError("Unsupported source file type: " + path)
+        item = identity(path)
+        if item["git_blob"] != expected[path]:
+            raise RuntimeError("Source differs from the exact merged inputs: " + path)
+        rows.append(item)
+    for path in [*OVERRIDES, *DEPENDENCIES]:
+        if path in missing or path not in expected:
+            raise RuntimeError("Required merge source absent: " + path)
+    raw = (json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n").encode()
+    return {
+        "head": DREAM, "head_tree": DREAM_TREE,
+        "tracked_materialized_count": len(rows),
+        "tracked_sparse_absent_count": len(missing),
+        "inventory_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
+        "important_sources": [r for r in rows if r["path"] in OVERRIDES or r["path"] in DEPENDENCIES],
+    }
+
+parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+parser.add_argument("mode", choices=["import", "probe"])
+args = parser.parse_args()
+directory = STAGE / "evidence" / ("integration-" + args.mode)
+directory.mkdir()
+before = snapshot()
+env = os.environ.copy()
+for key in ["LUMO_KART_MINIMAP_CAPTURE_DIR", "LUMO_CAPTURE_DIR", "DISPLAY"]:
+    env.pop(key, None)
+env["XDG_DATA_HOME"] = str(STAGE / ("user-integration-" + args.mode))
+if args.mode == "import":
+    command = ["godot", "--headless", "--editor", "--path", str(SOURCE), "--import", "--quit"]
+else:
+    env["LUMO_CAPTURE_DIR"] = str(directory)
+    command = [
+        "godot", "--path", str(SOURCE), "--rendering-method", "gl_compatibility",
+        "--headless", "--script", "res://scripts/tests/mobile_safe_area_regression.gd",
+    ]
+version = subprocess.check_output(["godot", "--version"], text=True).strip()
+started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+clock = time.monotonic()
+log = directory / "run.log"
+with log.open("w") as output:
+    try:
+        result = subprocess.run(command, env=env, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=180)
+        code = result.returncode
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        code = 124
+after = snapshot()
+data = log.read_bytes()
+report = directory / "mobile-safe-area.json"
+document = json.loads(report.read_text()) if report.is_file() else None
+record = {
+    "purpose": "one exact existing SafeArea probe on combined Dream and reviewed minimap source",
+    "mode": args.mode,
+    "base_head": DREAM,
+    "source_overrides": OVERRIDES,
+    "before": before, "after": after,
+    "sources_unchanged": before == after,
+    "engine_version": version,
+    "command": command,
+    "environment": {key: env.get(key) for key in [
+        "XDG_DATA_HOME", "DISPLAY", "LUMO_CAPTURE_DIR", "LUMO_KART_MINIMAP_CAPTURE_DIR"
+    ]},
+    "started_utc": started,
+    "seconds": round(time.monotonic() - clock, 3),
+    "exit_code": code,
+    "log_bytes": len(data),
+    "log_sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
+    "report_present": document is not None,
+    "checks": document.get("checks") if document else None,
+    "failures": document.get("failures") if document else None,
+    "report_sha256": hashlib.sha256(report.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if report.is_file() else None,
+    "rendered_capture_requested": False,
+}
+(directory / "run.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
+print(json.dumps(record, indent=2))
+print(data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")[-10000:])
+if before != after:
+    raise SystemExit("Tracked source changed during the integration run")
+raise SystemExit(code)

+# Original Lumo in the Hub and direct Village host return
+
+## Requirement and verified cause
+
+Heinz's existing requirement is to use the original Lumo character, with no replacement figure or newly generated asset. Visual review of the real integration captures found that the Hub always instantiated `lumo_character.tscn`, a primitive capsule/sphere/box character with a purple hoodie. That selection was unconditional. It was neither a selected child avatar nor a failed load of the genuine model. Merely naming this node `OriginalAnimatedLumo` had not proved asset identity.
+
+This targeted patch starts from `7d53f29e68269c21d1d5a66bdf3d488f8e886970` (tree `6f835356946d53c665cf235cd0c26071fdf643ee`). It changes two production scripts, strengthens existing tests and the existing Discovery checker, and adds one test-only identity inspector. It does not introduce or change any character asset or the shared rig adapter.
+
+## Hub behavior
+
+`game_hub.gd` now instantiates the same `lumo_rigged_actor.gd` used by the learning world. Its real imported resource is `res://assets/characters/lumo_facial/Lumo-Facial-Mobile.glb`, with the actual 65-bone skeleton, 9original clips and 2 bound body/facial meshes containing24,027 vertices. The existing eyelid adapter hides its eyelid mesh between blinks; the visible original body contributes21,659 vertices in these captures.
+
